description: This Java source file defines the 'AcknowledgementAggregator' class, which manages the collection, processing, and aggregation of acknowledgements related to a specific request within a messaging or event-driven system. It handles adding acknowledgement requests, receiving acknowledgements, tracking their status, and generating aggregated acknowledgement summaries, all within a context defined by entity ID and correlation ID.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAggregator
classes.description: A class that manages the collection, monitoring, and aggregation of acknowledgements for a specific request, identified by entity and correlation IDs, ensuring that all acknowledgements are received and successful before confirming completion.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of AcknowledgementAggregator for a given entity ID (or namespace), correlation ID, timeout, and header translator.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with this acknowledgement aggregator.

methods.name: addAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Adds an acknowledgement request to the aggregator, initializing its expected acknowledgement with a timeout acknowledgement instance.

methods.name: addAcknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Adds multiple acknowledgement requests to the aggregator at once.

methods.name: addReceivedAcknowledgment
methods.description: Processes a received acknowledgement: if expected, updates the stored acknowledgements and marks the label as no longer expected.

methods.name: receivedAllRequestedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks whether all expected acknowledgements have been received.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Determines whether all received acknowledgements are successful.

methods.name: getAggregatedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Constructs and returns an aggregate acknowledgements object representing the current state of acknowledgements.
